changelog: **Sales channels on the account** (#2408). New `CompanyChannel` (string key from `src/lib/salesChannels.ts`, status `USING`/`INTERESTED`/`DROPPED`, `@@unique([companyId, channel])`, in `TENANT_MODELS`). The marketing import's `channels` column now lands: names resolve through the vocabulary's aliases (`Amazon FBA`, `ebay.de`, `Shopware 6` …), an unknown name fails its row with the valid list, and a run only ADDS missing channels as `USING` — a re-run is UNCHANGED and never removes a channel or changes a status set by hand. The account page shows the channels; an ADMIN adds, re-statuses and removes them (`PUT`/`DELETE /api/admin/companies/[id]/channels`). The postal-campaign account picker filters on "sells on" a channel (USING only). Trendyol joins SaleVali's integration list as a tracked marketplace.

en: Accounts now show which marketplaces, shop systems and carriers a merchant uses — from the import or set by hand — and a postal campaign can target, say, every OTTO seller.
tr: Hesaplar artık tüccarın hangi pazaryeri, mağaza sistemi ve kargo firmasını kullandığını gösteriyor — içe aktarımdan ya da elle — ve bir posta kampanyası örneğin tüm OTTO satıcılarını hedefleyebiliyor.
de: Accounts zeigen jetzt, welche Marktplätze, Shopsysteme und Versanddienstleister ein Händler nutzt — aus dem Import oder von Hand gepflegt — und eine Briefkampagne kann z. B. gezielt alle OTTO-Händler ansprechen.
